thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created — elevated 5xx rate observed from control-plane (auth/org-lookup path). Paging oncall (alex) and eng-sre. Auto-sampled traces attached: trace_id=ff12a3c4

alex: saw the pager, looking now. any customer-facing impact?

priya: yes, we're getting a subset of requests returning 502/504 from the gateway. CI/CD dashboards show spike at 10:12 UTC. Some customers reporting feature degradation (org metadata failing).

sam: logs from auth-service show repeated downstream failure to config-service cache lookup: "cache miss + config-fetch timeout" then auth returns 500. attaching sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:41Z auth-service ERROR req=abcd1234 upstream=config-svc timeout=1500ms
2026-03-15T10:12:41Z auth-service WARN req=abcd1234 cache key=org-123 stale=true
2026-03-15T10:12:41Z config-svc ERROR fetch org-123 db=timeout
```

jamie: config-service metrics show a sudden rise in DB latency around 10:10, followed by cache invalidation jobs failing (redis connections flapping). Could be a config-deploy earlier?

marta: I deployed a small config patch at 09:58 that toggles the cache TTL behavior. I rolled it forward but did not touch connection pooling. I can roll back if we suspect it.

alex: actionable checklist: (1) confirm customer impact (2) triage root cause (3) apply mitigation (fallback to cached org metadata / increase circuit breaker) (4) coordinate handoff to oncall infra if DB/resource issue.

priya: customer impact tracker updated: 8 tenants affected, a few support tickets opened. Marking P1 for now.

sam: quick mitigation idea: route auth org-lookup to read-only fallback cache (stale_ok) while we fix config-service. We have a runtime flag: `AUTH_ORG_FALLBACK=true` we can flip via console.

jamie: I agree, also lower circuit-breaker sensitivity on auth->config to avoid cascading 5xx. current settings: `failures=5 window=30s`. bump to `failures=10 window=60s` for short term.

marta: rolling back my change now to rule out TTL bug. executing: `kubectl -n controlplane rollout undo deploy/config-svc --to-revision=3`

incident-bot: deploy-vitals: config-svc rollback started by marta at 10:18 UTC. Expected duration ~40s.

alex: I'm going to flip the fallback flag and loosen circuit breaker. Priya — if you can own the customer comms we can avoid duplicate messages.

priya: on it. pinging support to update status page: "Investigating elevated errors for org metadata requests; fallback enabled to reduce errors; mitigation in progress."

sam: flipping fallback now: `POST /runtime-flags AUTH_ORG_FALLBACK=true` -> 200 OK.

jamie: adjusting circuit-breaker: `cbctl set auth->config failures=10 window=60s` -> applied to all regions.

incident-bot: metric update: 5xx rate dropped from 4.5% to 1.1% within 2 minutes of mitigation actions.

alex: good sign. Logs still show some traces of timeouts but much reduced. keep monitoring for 15m. If rollback doesn't stabilize DB latency, we escalate to infra/persistence.

marta: rollback finished, observed config-svc pods back to ready and redis reconnects successful. logs show cache invalidation job now succeeding.

sam: tracing a lingering error: trace_id=ff12a3c4 shows a retry storm where auth retried 3x before giving 502. We should add request coalescing to prevent stampeding for hot org keys. filing ticket: https://issues/internal/RED-2418

priya: support updated status page and sent proactive note to affected customers. One customer asked for an incident timeline; I'll draft once we have root cause.

alex: initial incident summary for postmortem: cascade started after a config change to cache TTL which coincided with a brief DB latency spike; cache invalidation jobs failed leading to auth hitting config-service more often; circuit-breaker thresholds were too sensitive causing 5xx amplification. Immediate mitigations: rollback config change, enable AUTH_ORG_FALLBACK, loosen circuit-breaker.

jamie: recommend next steps: (1) postmortem to include deploy gating for cache-related changes, (2) add short-term request coalescing for org lookups, (3) run resilience tests for cache invalidation job under DB latency.

marta: will open the postmortem doc and assign owners.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation applied, customers impacted reduced, monitoring continuing. Pager cleared for oncall (alex) at 10:30 UTC.

alex: handing off to priya for follow-ups and postmortem. I'm available if escalation needed.

priya: taking handoff — will own timeline, customer comms, and the RCA doc. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

marta: adding a short-term dashboard to track auth->config latency and 5xxs, will alert if either crosses threshold again.

sam: pushed a small hotfix to add request coalescing in the auth cache layer behind a feature flag; will stage it behind rollout and monitor.

priya: marking thread as open for postmortem; will update when RCA draft ready.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 10:37 UTC — will re-open if error rate rises above threshold.

alex: thanks team. great coordination.
